evidence_cards.content: PPLI data available from J2 messages shall be used by C2 JUs to reduce the redundancy of surveillance track reporting.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This sentence explicitly states the objective (goal) of the primary actor (C2 JU) in the context of integrating PPLI reports with surveillance data, which is directly related to publishing Ballistic Missile Surveillance Reports as per the use case.

evidence_cards.content: The JU shall transmit Ballistic Missile Surveillance Reports (specifically Impact Point and/or Launch Point messages) upon transmission or reception of a Drop Track Report for a ballistic missile.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This sentence explicitly describes the core objective of the use case: publishing surveillance reports in response to specific tracking events.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU shall report on all uncorrelated local ballistic missile tracks and shall assume R² for those tracks in accordance with the R² rules as specified in paragraph 4.4.6.15.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This sentence explicitly states the reporting obligation of the C2 JU regarding ballistic missile tracks, which defines the high-level objective (goal) of the use case.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU with R2 for the Reference TN shall respond with a J3.6 Space Track message upon receipt of a J7.1 message with the Data Update Request Action field set to value 2, Ballistic Missile Update Request, on a specific TN.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This sentence defines the primary objective and response action of the C2 JU when processing a ballistic missile data update request, which directly corresponds to the 'goal' of the use case.

evidence_cards.content: A JU shall not transmit an initial surveillance report on a ballistic missile if the predicted time to impact is less than 16 seconds.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This establishes a mandatory state constraint (time-to-impact threshold) that must be evaluated before the reporting action can proceed; failure to meet this condition prevents the use case from starting.

evidence_cards.content: If the altitude of the descending ballistic missile is less than 8 data miles, an initial Ballistic Missile surveillance report shall not be transmitted.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This establishes a second mandatory state constraint (altitude threshold) that acts as a precondition for initiating the surveillance report transmission.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU must continuously correlate locally derived ballistic missile tracks with those reported on the Surveillance NPG to determine if data points are currently reported and if there are conflicts.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This describes a mandatory ongoing system state (continuous correlation) that serves as a prerequisite for determining reporting obligations and resolving conflicts before specific reports can be generated or transmitted.

evidence_cards.content: A JU without R² for a nonreal-time track (i.e., TQ field set to value 0) shall assume R² for that track when the track is locally updated by a new nonreal-time report.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a specific state condition regarding track responsibility (R²) and track quality (TQ) that must be established before the JU can proceed with reporting logic described in subsequent rules.

evidence_cards.content: The exchange of Ballistic Missile surveillance information on the interface requires procedures to recognize and resolve detected information differences between local data and data being reported on the interface.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Establishes a system-wide precondition that difference recognition and resolution procedures must be active/available for the exchange of ballistic missile surveillance information.

evidence_cards.content: C2 JUs participating in the exchange of J3 Surveillance messages shall transmit surveillance information in Network PGs as defined in paragraph 4.2.3.10.5.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Establishes that participation in J3 Surveillance message exchange is a required system state/condition for C2 JUs before they can publish Ballistic Missile Surveillance Reports (which are part of J3 data).

evidence_cards.content: A C2 JU shall assume R² of an IU (including C² and nonC² JUs and forwarded PUs and RUs) in accordance with the reporting rules for a real-time track if the C² JU has correlated local sensor data.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This sentence establishes the specific system state that must hold before the use case can begin: the C2 JU must have already correlated local sensor data to assume responsibility for the Interface Unit.

evidence_cards.content: Ballistic Missile surveillance tracks exist as the subject of data exchange requirements.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: The existence of 'Ballistic Missile surveillance tracks' is a necessary system state prerequisite for any reporting or data exchange regarding them to occur.

evidence_cards.content: A JU shall not transmit an initial surveillance report on a ballistic missile if the predicted time to impact is less than 16 seconds.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This establishes a system state condition (predicted time to impact) that must hold before the use case can begin; specifically, the time must be greater than or equal to 16 seconds for the report to be transmitted.

evidence_cards.content: If the altitude of the descending ballistic missile is less than 8 data miles, an initial Ballistic Missile surveillance report shall not be transmitted.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This establishes another system state condition (altitude) that must hold before the use case can begin; specifically, the altitude must be greater than or equal to 8 data miles for the report to be transmitted.

evidence_cards.content: Each C² JU has the responsibility to determine whether the data points being detected by its local sensors are currently reported on the interface and if there are any conflicts between locally derived information and information reported on the interface.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Establishes a mandatory operational state where the C² JU must be actively monitoring and correlating local sensor data with interface reports before publishing ballistic missile surveillance reports; this continuous correlation is a precondition for valid reporting under R² rules.

evidence_cards.content: To accomplish this, each C² JU must continuously correlate locally derived ballistic missile tracks with ballistic missile tracks reported on the Surveillance NPG.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies that continuous correlation between local tracks and Surveillance NPG tracks is a required system state prior to assuming R² or resolving conflicts — thus a precondition for publishing accurate surveillance reports.

evidence_cards.content: The JU must currently have R² (Responsibility) for the ballistic missile track in order to transmit a J7.0 Drop Track Report message when ceasing reporting.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This establishes a necessary system state (holding R²) that must exist before the JU can execute the action of transmitting a Drop Track Report to terminate its own reporting.

evidence_cards.content: A JU with R² for a line or area shall transmit the entire line or area upon receipt of a J7.1 (ACT = 1) for any TN used to define the line or area.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Establishes a system state condition (JU possessing R² data for a specific TN) that must hold before the JU can respond to a surveillance request, which is a precondition for publishing reports based on such requests.

evidence_cards.content: All C² JUs receiving a J7.1 (ACT = 1) message containing their own TN shall transmit J10.2 Engagement Status messages...
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Identifies a specific condition (receipt of a J7.1 message addressed to the JU's own TN) required to trigger status reporting actions, serving as a contextual precondition for this specific flow.

evidence_cards.content: The use case is triggered upon transmission or reception of a Drop Track Report for a ballistic missile.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This explicitly defines the event that initiates the reporting obligation for Impact Point and/or Launch Point messages.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU shall resolve the difference by transmitting the appropriate J7 message, by operator procedure, or by voice coordination.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Identifies a specific trigger condition ('event of conflict') and the resulting actions that initiate a reporting flow (transmitting J7), which serves as evidence for the trigger slot regarding how reports are initiated via operator action.

evidence_cards.content: The use case is triggered when a JU ceases reporting a ballistic missile track for which it currently has R².
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This section explicitly defines the transmission of the Drop Track Report message as occurring when the JU ceases reporting a track it holds responsibility for, identifying this cessation as the initiating event.

evidence_cards.content: Upon transmission or reception of a Drop Track Report for a ballistic missile, the JU with R² of the Launch Point or Impact Point shall transmit the Impact Point and/or Launch Point messages with the Connect/Disconnect field set to value 1, Disconnect.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the primary action in the main flow: transmitting the surveillance report immediately following the trigger event (Drop Track Report).

evidence_cards.content: Any subsequent reports of the Impact Point or Launch Point shall be transmitted with the Related 2 Track Number field Of the J3.0C5 message set to value 0, No Statement.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies the data formatting requirement for the continuation of the reporting interaction within the main flow.

evidence_cards.content: In the event of conflict between locally derived information and information reported on the interface, the C2 JU shall resolve the difference by transmitting the appropriate J7 message, by operator procedure, or by voice coordination.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This describes an exception handling step that occurs during the main flow when a conflict is detected — it defines how the actor resolves discrepancies before proceeding with reporting, thus constraining the normal interaction sequence.

evidence_cards.content: Each C2 JU must continuously correlate locally derived ballistic missile tracks with ballistic missile tracks reported on the Surveillance NPG.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This is a continuous activity that supports the main flow by ensuring track consistency prior to and during reporting; it is part of the canonical success scenario’s preparatory and ongoing steps.

evidence_cards.content: Each C2 JU shall report on all uncorrelated local ballistic missile tracks and shall assume R² for those tracks in accordance with the R² rules as specified in paragraph 4.4.6.15.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This specifies a mandatory action within the main flow: reporting uncorrelated tracks and assuming responsibility (R²) for them, which is a core step in publishing surveillance reports.

evidence_cards.content: A JU relinquishes R² for a ballistic missile track upon reception of a remote track report with TQ greater than local TQ.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the step where the primary actor loses responsibility (R²) for the track based on incoming data quality, which is part of the interaction flow leading to or following the trigger.

evidence_cards.content: After applying all other rules, a JU relinquishes R² for a real-time track upon reception of a remote track report with TQ equal to the local TQ from a JU whose Source TN is greater than the local Source TN.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines an alternative condition in the main flow for relinquishing responsibility based on source priority when data quality is equal.

evidence_cards.content: A unit assuming R² for a ballistic missile track need not assume R² for the associated launch point.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Clarifies the scope of the action in the main flow: assuming responsibility for the missile track does not automatically transfer responsibility for the launch point.

evidence_cards.content: If a correlation is found with a track for which the C2 JU has R2 and the TNs are different, the J7.2 (RV = 1) Correlation message shall be transmitted, with the Source TN in the Header word of the J2 PPLI message as the Retained TN and the surveillance TN as the Dropped TN.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes an alternative flow where the C2 JU resolves a conflict by retaining its own track and dropping the incoming PPLI track, diverging from the main flow of transmitting reports.

evidence_cards.content: If a correlation is found with a track for which another C2 JU has R2 and the TNs are different, the J7.2 (RV = 1) Correlation message shall be transmitted, with the Source TN in the Header word of the J2 PPLI message as the Retained TN and the surveillance TN as the Dropped TN.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes an alternative flow where the C2 JU yields to another JU's track when TNs differ, diverging from the main flow of transmitting reports.

evidence_cards.content: If a correlation is found with a track for which another C2 JU has R2 and the TNs are the same, the JU receiving the J2 shall accept the PPLI information into its surveillance database and shall disregard the J3 surveillance data on the specified track except when Geodetic Position Quality in the PPLI message is set to value 0, in which case the surveillance track is accepted and the PPLI message shall be discarded.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes an alternative flow where the C2 JU accepts external data or retains local data based on quality flags, diverging from the standard reporting path.

evidence_cards.content: Established local ballistic missile tracks/points that cannot be correlated with a remote track/point received by the detecting JU shall be reported with all known parameters, except covariance, at the next reporting opportunity.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines an alternative flow for handling uncorrelated local tracks distinct from the standard correlation/disconnect process.

evidence_cards.content: If a J7.0 (ACT = 0) Drop Track Report message is received, the R² unit is declared inactive, or if no periodic update is received for three consecutive update intervals, another IU may, by operator action only, assume R² for the point using the same Reference TN.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes an alternative flow for transferring responsibility (R²) when the primary holder drops the track or fails to update.

evidence_cards.content: Any subsequent reports of the Impact Point or Launch Point [after a Drop Track Report] shall be transmitted with the Related 2 Track Number field Of the J3.0C5 message set to value 0, No Statement.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies the data configuration for the alternative flow of reporting points after the initial disconnect event.

evidence_cards.content: If reported, friendly interceptor missile tracks shall be reported on the interface using the J3.2 Air Track message for missiles capable only of endoatmospheric intercepts, and the J3.6 Space Track message for interceptors capable of exoatmospheric intercepts.
